story_position: Chapter 1 cleanup window — optional Character-Life C05
scene_purpose: Use Ilyra changing Maevra's splint as an ordinary reason for the two women to spend time together, quietly reinforce the Chapter-1 broken-arm state and healing-magic limitation, then let the scene become an off-duty argument about Maevra's terrible serialized fiction rather than a medical lecture or Cyanis-management scene.

scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Ilyra removes/checks/replaces Maevra's splint and uses one restrained healing-magic effect to ease pain. The magic does not mend the fracture. Keep medical staging economical: old/new splint state, one brief magic cue, portraits/dialogue. Maevra reads a bad serialized adventure-romance while Ilyra works. The bad-fiction conversation becomes the dominant scene. Cyanis can join later; Torren contributes only briefly.

required_character_truths: Maevra's arm was broken during the Broken Convoy attack before Chapter 1.
The arm remains broken at Junction camp.
Ilyra can maintain the splint and ease pain with magic but cannot magically mend the broken bone.
Maevra genuinely enjoys bad popular fiction and dislikes spoilers.
Ilyra and Maevra get an adult friendship beat independent of managing Cyanis.
Cyanis joins the ridiculous conversation rather than becoming its emotional subject.
